title: Taj Mahal at Dawn
description: The iconic marble mausoleum glows pink at dawn, a testament to Mughal architectural genius and eternal love.

title: Amber Fort, Jaipur
description: Perched atop the Aravalli hills, Amber Fort's golden sandstone walls mirror the city's royal heritage.

title: Mysore Palace Illuminated
description: On Sunday evenings, over 96,000 light bulbs illuminate the Mysore Palace, creating one of India's most spectacular night sights.

title: Hampi Virupaksha Temple
description: The ancient Virupaksha Temple has been in continuous worship since the 7th century CE, surrounded by the surreal boulder landscape of Hampi.

title: Valley of Flowers, Uttarakhand
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this remote Himalayan valley blooms with hundreds of wild alpine flower species every monsoon.

title: Dal Lake Sunrise, Kashmir
description: Shikara boats glide through the still morning waters of Dal Lake as the Zabarwan mountains catch the first light of day.

title: Munnar Tea Gardens
description: Rolling emerald hills blanketed in tea bushes at 1,600 metres elevation — Munnar's tea estates produce some of India's finest teas.

title: Bengal Tiger, Ranthambore
description: Ranthambore National Park is one of India's best places to spot the Bengal tiger in the wild, often seen near the historic fort ruins.

title: Flamingos at Thol Lake
description: Every winter, thousands of lesser flamingos turn the wetlands of Gujarat a brilliant pink, one of India's most iconic wildlife spectacles.

title: Hyderabadi Biryani
description: Dum-cooked over slow coal fire, Hyderabadi Biryani is a UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage — layers of saffron rice, tender meat, and kewra water.

title: Chole Bhature, Delhi Streets
description: Puffed golden bhatura paired with spiced chickpea curry — a Delhi street-food institution served since the 1950s at Sitaram Diwan Chand.

title: Kerala Sadya on Banana Leaf
description: A traditional Onam Sadya is a 26-course feast served on a fresh banana leaf — each dish placed in a specific position according to centuries-old tradition.

title: Holi — Festival of Colours
description: Celebrated in Mathura and Vrindavan with particular intensity, Holi marks the triumph of good over evil and the arrival of spring with clouds of vibrant colour powder.

title: Diwali — Varanasi Ghats
description: During Dev Deepawali (Diwali of the Gods), the 84 ghats of Varanasi are lit by over a million earthen lamps reflected in the Ganges — a vision of timeless devotion.

title: Durga Puja Pandal, Kolkata
description: Kolkata's Durga Puja transforms the city into the world's largest open-air art installation — thousands of themed pandals (pavilions) compete for the most spectacular installation.
